verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a scriptable terminal, for example acting on many windows or tabs at once, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents and hands-on verifies remote control against individual windows (send-text to any window, ls, get-text, close-window). Nothing shows a single operation applied across many items at once, and looping over windows in a user script is a workaround, not product support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
